summary: See what people and agents did across the workspace, by day, filtered by type or person.
intent: Block: what happened across a workspace. Events from people and agents, newest first and grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, then dates), each with an Avatar, a verb line, its object, a time and Badges; Type and Person filters; Open and Reply on each event; Load more at the end.
useWhen: a workspace or project activity page
catch up on what people and agents did since yesterday
jump from an event to the thing it happened to, or reply to a comment
doNotUseWhen: the steps of one agent run — AgentTrail or RunDetail
a queue of things waiting on you — AgentInbox
toasts for what just happened — NotificationStack

events.note: { id, type: "comment" | "change" | "run" | "member" | "billing", actor: { id, name, kind?: "person" | "agent", src?, initials? }, verb, object, at: epoch ms | ISO string, detail?, status?: { label, tone? }, canReply? }[]. Any order; shown newest first in day groups. verb is lower case ("commented on") so the line reads actor + verb + object.

filters.note: Controlled { types: type[], people: actorId[] }. Empty arrays mean no filter on that axis. Filtering is over the loaded events; an app that filters on the server keeps filters controlled and replaces events.

onOpen.note: (eventId) => void. Each event gets an Open button (named Open + the object) when set.

onReply.note: (eventId) => void. Comment events get Reply (named Reply to + the actor) when set; canReply: false hides it on one event.

onLoadMore.note: () => void. Fetch the next page and append it to events.

hasMore.note: Load more shows when this is true and onLoadMore is set.

loading.note: Skeleton rows: the whole feed with no events yet, else under the list. Load more reads Loading… and ignores clicks, keeping focus.

now.note: Epoch ms for Today / Yesterday. Default the time of first render.

timeZone.note: IANA zone for day groups and times. Pass it when the server and the viewer may differ.

description.note: Line under the title. Default: how many events show, and how many match the filters.

layout: head: h2 and count line, with the filter group (Type, Person, Clear filters) at the end; it wraps under the title when narrow
one section per day, labelled by its h3 (Today, Yesterday, Mon 9 Nov), over a card-surface ordered list of events
an event row is Avatar, the copy (verb line, optional detail, time with Badges) and its actions at the end
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-sm (40rem) of block width the actions move under the copy

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
each day is a section labelled by its h3, whose name carries the day's event count

each event is a list item that reads as one sentence: who (and that it is an agent), the verb, the object, any status, the detail, then the day and time; the visual row is hidden from screen readers so nothing is read twice
Open is named Open + the object and Reply is named Reply to + the actor, so a list of buttons is still clear
the filters are a group named Filter activity; Type and Person are kit FilterButtons that open a Popover dialog of kit Checkboxes in a fieldset; the chip's name carries the picked value or count
Load more is a real button described by the count line; while loading it stays focusable and says Loading…
what Load more brings in is announced in a polite status region ("5 more events loaded, 2 match the filters."); filter changes are announced there too
when the last page arrives and Load more goes away, focus moves to the first new event that shows
no motion of its own; Skeleton's shimmer stops under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not rebuild ActivityFeed from a local list; import the block
Do not put a solid primary in the feed; Open and Reply are ghost, Load more is outline
Do not put a sentence in verb; verb is the phrase between the actor and the object
Do not use Badge for people; Avatar is the person or agent, the Agent Badge only says it is an agent
snippet: <ActivityFeed events={events} onOpen={openEvent} onReply={replyTo} onLoadMore={loadNextPage} hasMore={hasMore} loading={loading} />
